sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The link previews are on by default (org/non-MB-sites.org): "Preview linked entities on hover", "Also preview links outside tables" and "Preview external links on hover" are ticked, and so are "Show every preview on a plain hover (without Ctrl)" and the release page's "Show the \"#\" release group card on a plain hover (without Ctrl)". Resting the pointer on a link is enough for its card, with no Ctrl. A card that shows asks for its data, and MusicBrainz requests share their one-a-second pace with the Relationships column. Switch "Show every preview on a plain hover" off to get the Ctrl gate back. A profile that has stored the old "off" from an earlier SAVE keeps it, unless its one-time settings migration has not run yet: the five keys are in _SETTINGS_MIGRATIONS, but the migration level stays at 1, so a profile already migrated is not re-examined.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Link previews on phones and tablets have their own switches: "Preview linked entities on touch devices", "Also preview links outside tables on touch devices" and "Preview external links on touch devices", all off by default. On a touch-primary device (no hover, coarse pointer) each one takes the place of its desktop switch. On a desktop they do nothing. With them off, a tap on a link opens its page as usual. With one on, a tap opens the preview window instead (↗ in the window opens the page).

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: New _popSettingOn(key): every read of sa_pop_mb, sa_pop_mb_page and sa_pop_ext (_mbEntitySource(), _extSource()) goes through it. On a touch-primary device (_isTouchPrimaryDevice()) it reads the key's _on_touch twin INSTEAD of the key, so the twin replaces the switch rather than gating it. New settings sa_pop_mb_on_touch, sa_pop_mb_page_on_touch and sa_pop_ext_on_touch (default false). The defaults of sa_pop_mb, sa_pop_mb_page, sa_pop_ext, sa_dp_hover_without_ctrl and sa_event_rg_tooltip_without_ctrl change to true, each with a _SETTINGS_MIGRATIONS entry was: [false].

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: Tests. tests/support/loadPage.js's FIXTURE_SETTINGS_OVERRIDE forces the five preview keys off, as it does artwork and Relationships: otherwise a hover in any fixture spec pops a card and leaves the sandbox. A spec gets a schema default back by seeding the key as undefined.

Specs updated: popup-mb.spec.js and popup-ext.spec.js ("off when switched off", the schema defaults, the touch twin doing nothing on a desktop), popup-mb.mobile.spec.js (rewritten: a twin replaces its switch, a phone keeps its links, the page-wide scope on touch), popup-ext.mobile.spec.js and popup-ext-foreign.mobile.spec.js (seed the twins), and release-event-colours-rg-tooltip.spec.js (the "#" card's default).

settings-dialog(-header).spec.js now derive their PRISTINE set from the override. settings-migration.spec.js un-seeds the override, because the five preview keys are now retired defaults the migration would adopt.
capture-interaction-perf.js seeds the preview keys off (PREVIEWS_OFF), so its arms stay comparable.
Mutations. New scripts/mutations/popup-touch-twins.json (11 entries, all caught). Anchors and greps were updated in popup-mb.json, popup-ext.json and ctrl-hover-art-multiselect.json.

Test flake fixed: popup-mb.spec.js "Ctrl+click keeps the link's own new tab" timed out about 1 run in 8. The cause: Playwright 1.62.1 sometimes never emits the context's 'page' event for a Ctrl+click background tab, even though the tab opens and loads (shown by a trace). The spec now checks the new tab's navigation request instead. A new popup-mb.json mutation ("Ctrl+click in the window is swallowed") pins the case where the click is prevented without a drill-down. The userscript is unchanged.

HELP, docs/claude/detail-pages.md (a new "Touch twins" rule), release-tracks-and-length.md, settings-and-config.md, CLAUDE.md and PERFORMANCE.org (the shared queue is now reached by a plain hover) were updated, as were the settings' own descriptions.
